sourceProjection.basis: The Arnold Wolff nave drawing is a top-down architectural plan, with pier profiles and vault linework separately visible. It is not the visitor leaflet's cathedral elevation or aerial image.

review: Cologne Cathedral art competition publication, printed p11 / PDF p13. Arnold Wolff architectural ground plan, visually checked orthographic. Image72 contains only architectural ink, no textual legend. Thick black masonry and pier footprints are low walls; fine vault/rib lines stay flat. No room numbers printed, so none invented. Cardinal directions follow the west-to-east church axis, not screen north.
limitations: 本图保留教堂主层的柱墩、侧廊、耳堂和环形后殿。细线包含拱顶投影，按平面细节显示，不挤出成隔墙。
原图没有展厅编号，使用空间名称定位；墙高仅用于显示。
南塔、登塔楼梯和珍宝馆各层平面尚未核验，本图不代表完整组合票参观路线。

rasterLayers.reason: Black masonry/column footprints separated from fine vault projection by a five-source-pixel opening; removed fine ink remains a flat detail layer.
